subject.title: refactor(channels): centralize inbound orchestration and remove internal compat

question: Should this exact centralized Plugin Runtime and SDK boundary be accepted for the broad channel migration after the runtime-mock defect and proof gap are resolved?
rationale: The mechanical defect is clear, but accepting the breadth, new runtime seam, and compatibility rollout across nearly every channel requires explicit core/channel owner judgment.

options.title: Fix and prove exact head
options.body: Retain the centralized design, repair routed-turn assembly in the runtime mock, and require representative live delivery, session-continuity, and upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Split the migration
options.body: Land the core seam with a small proven channel subset, then migrate remaining transports through independently reviewed follow-ups.

options.title: Pause the refactor
options.body: Retain current main behavior until maintainers are prepared to own the cross-channel compatibility and rollout risk.

recommendation.title: Fix and prove exact head
recommendation.body: Retain the centralized design, repair routed-turn assembly in the runtime mock, and require representative live delivery, session-continuity, and upgrade proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked issue and complete implementation stack establish steipete as the clearest owner of the intended channel/core boundary.
